semantics.rss: sampled termination trigger with observed overshoot; not an OS hard memory ceiling
semantics.cpu: POSIX RLIMIT_CPU inherited per process; not an aggregate tree CPU budget
semantics.file_size: POSIX RLIMIT_FSIZE inherited per file plus parent census; not an aggregate disk hard limit
semantics.artifact_aggregate_and_count: sampled census triggers; crossing can overshoot between samples
semantics.wall: parent monotonic phase and campaign deadlines outside the Node event loop

import json, threading
from test_controller_process import ControllerProcessTests as T
from controller_process import run_controller

def one(action, caps_kwargs=None, abort_after=None):
    case=T()
    case.setUp()
    try:
        caps=case.caps(**(caps_kwargs or {}))
        event=None
        timer=None
        if abort_after is not None:
            event=threading.Event(); timer=threading.Timer(abort_after,event.set); timer.start()
        try:
            receipt=run_controller(case.config(action,caps=caps),abort_event=event)
        finally:
            if timer is not None: timer.cancel()
        return {
          "action":action,"status":receipt.status,"reason":receipt.terminal_reason,
          "elapsed_seconds":receipt.elapsed_seconds,"returncode":receipt.returncode,
          "peak_rss_bytes":receipt.resources.peak_sampled_rss_bytes,
          "rss_overshoot_bytes":receipt.resources.rss_overshoot_bytes,
          "sample_count":receipt.resources.sample_count,
          "max_sample_gap_ms":receipt.resources.max_sample_gap_ms,
          "largest_file_bytes":receipt.resources.census_largest_file_bytes,
          "signals":list(receipt.cleanup.signals_sent),
          "tracked_processes":len(receipt.cleanup.tracked_processes),
          "cleanup_confirmed":receipt.cleanup.confirmed_for_tracked_processes,
        }
    finally: case.tearDown()
